modules.title: Introduction to Siffofi (Adjectives and Adverbs)
modules.html:
Words used to describe nouns and verbs in Hausa. This section covers introduction to siffofi (adjectives and adverbs).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of siffofi (adjectives and adverbs).
  • Be able to explain siffofi (adjectives and adverbs) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Kammala karin maganar nan: 'Kowa ya ci zomo, _____.'
A: ya ci gudu — The complete proverb is 'Kowa ya ci zomo, ya ci gudu', which translates to 'Whoever eats a rabbit must run like one' (consequences follow actions).

Q: Wacce sana'a ce ake amfani da 'Kira' a cikinta?
A: Kira (Blacksmithing) — The term 'Kira' refers specifically to blacksmithing, where metal tools are produced.

quiz.q: Kammala karin maganar nan: 'Kowa ya ci zomo, _____.'
quiz.solution: The complete proverb is 'Kowa ya ci zomo, ya ci gudu', which translates to 'Whoever eats a rabbit must run like one' (consequences follow actions).

quiz.q: Wacce sana'a ce ake amfani da 'Kira' a cikinta?
quiz.solution: The term 'Kira' refers specifically to blacksmithing, where metal tools are produced.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Bakari' (Consonant) mai fashewa (Ejective)?
quiz.solution: In Hausa phonology, K' (k tare da lamba) is an ejective consonant, produced with high pressure.

quiz.q: Wanne ne cikin wadannan ba Fi'ili (Verb) ba ne?
quiz.solution: Gudu (run), Cin abinci (eat), and Kwana (sleep) are actions, while Kyakkyawa (beautiful) is an adjective.

quiz.q: Wanne sashi na gaba (Syllable) ne 'Ma-ran-ta-wa'?
quiz.solution: Ma-ran-ta-wa has four syllables.

quiz.q: A fannin sarauta, wanene yake biye da Sarki?
quiz.solution: The 'Waziri' acts as the Prime Minister or the highest advisor to the King (Sarki).

quiz.q: Menene 'Jinsin miji' (Masculine)?
quiz.solution: In most contexts, 'Yaya' (older brother) is masculine, while the others are feminine.

quiz.q: Wanne ne kalmar nuni na nesa (Far demonstrative)?
quiz.solution: 'Wancan' means 'that one over there', used for distant objects.

quiz.q: Kalmar 'Guda' a cikin lissafi tana nufin _____.
quiz.solution: 'Guda' acts as a counter for individual units or items.

quiz.q: Menene 'Ami' (Tone) a Hausa?
quiz.solution: Hausa is a tonal language; 'Ami' represents the rising or falling pitch in speech.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Bakarin hanci' (Nasal consonant)?
quiz.solution: 'M' and 'N' are nasal consonants produced through the nose.

quiz.q: Wanene 'Malam'?
quiz.solution: 'Malam' is used for an educated person or teacher.

quiz.q: Jam'in 'Gida':
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Gidaje.

quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Rana.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Kasuwanci'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Business/Trading.
